notes.account: The page continues an explanation of a sheaf-gluing functor φ by p_*j^* after restriction to the tilded space. It rewrites gluing data using an adjoint map p^*F₀ → j^*F̃₁, recalls the fibration and boundary-inclusion geometry, and offers two alternative diagrams, first with target X₀ and then with target T. These are the manuscript’s assertions, not proven topological conclusions of this reading.
notes.explicit_author_uncertainty: No explicit mathematical doubt is stated on this page. “Si on préfère” offers an alternative presentation, and “un peu moins joli (mais un peu plus canonique)” qualifies that presentation stylistically.
notes.page_date_title_evidence: Author number 31 is at the top centre; archive pencil 176 is at the lower left. No date or title appears. The opening haut is a continuation, not a title.
notes.math_triggered_reading_decisions: Adjunction requires the two displayed stars in L8 to be superscripts and makes the plain F₀ reading coherent, but the ink was independently checked: the F has only two horizontal strokes. The preceding replacement of X₀ by T supports the foot target T conceptually, yet T/I is retained because the lower trace meets the page edge.
notes.paragraphs: The indented Si on préfère and extra vertical gap begin the second paragraph. No new paragraph is imposed merely at a sentence start after the diagrams.
notes.marks: No independent author underline or separator was identified. The heavy lines at L5 and L13 cancel words. A compact dark stroke left of D4 is reproduced without assigning authorship or meaning. A detached point immediately below the comma in L18’s crop is treated as a fragment at that comma’s tip, not a new mathematical or sentence mark; faint grey specks elsewhere are not promoted to text.
notes.H_editorial_note: H’s note about the bottom diagram crossing to the next author page is contradicted by this scan’s visible complete upper row and both labelled arrows. The note itself is not transcribed as manuscript text.
notes.proof_scope: Only the conditional local adjunction correspondence and diagram source/target compatibility were checked. No proof was attempted of the restriction equivalence, the genuine-fibration assertion, the boundary-variety assertion, or the claimed homotopy relation.

check_events.outcome: The displayed gluing-map reformulation is formally consistent, conditional on φ(F₁) ≃ p_*j^*(F̃₁) and the usual adjunction p^* ⊣ p_*.
check_events.method: Put B=j^*(F̃₁). A map u:F₀→p_*B gives ũ=ε_B∘p^*u:p^*F₀→B. Conversely u=p_*ũ∘η_F₀. The two triangle identities make the assignments inverse. This checks the variance and the two superscript stars in the second display; it does not establish the topological hypotheses.
